test_title: PYST 53: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question:
The following pie chart shows the number of students who failed in different subjects in an examination. Examine the chart and answer the following question. The total number of students who have failed is 350.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03067c8400ac7b5ba5e9f56e92c0eee7bf858bae32d47d4581084fd005f404de.png] 

The number of students failed in mathematics is less than the number of students failed in all other subjects by:
solution:
**Given:**

The total number of students who have failed is 350

**Calculation:**

According to the question:

⇒ (73% - 27%) of 350

⇒ 46% of 350

⇒ 161

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
